verdict.rationale: PagerDuty supports rule-based automation via Event Orchestration (auto-deduplicate/suppress alerts, routing rules), Incident Workflows with explicit 'if-this-then-that' trigger/action logic (e.g., auto-trigger workflows for P1/P2 incidents), and escalation policies that automatically assign/escalate based on conditions, all exposed via REST/Events APIs and webhooks for programmatic/AI-driven configuration. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of workflow automation reliability at scale, and clearer documentation on natural-language/AI-authored rule creation rather than UI/API-based configuration.
